actual_blender_pose_review.views: 7 aligned genuine Blender PBR stills per version, fixed camera and light, sampled 1/10/19/27/34/46/65
strengths: Distinct 12-bone armature with elbow and knee child segments and smooth distal influence
No artificial translation of the root, idle start and end remain identical
No obvious tearing in sampled broad poses at 600x480
problems: Compared with V2 at attack frame 27, the active claw does not extend nearly as far: the pose reads as crouch rather than forceful swipe.
Most distal articulation differences remain local and the overall silhouette improvement is not clearly stronger from this view.
PBR isolated images and structural checks do not certify animation quality in strategic Unity gameplay.

next_hypothesis: Keep 12-bone skin/weights from v3 and design v4 attack with stronger upper-arm reaching action plus controlled forearm bend, while preventing torso-wide dragging. Do authentic matched v3-v4 frames and check source/clip and no-credit gates.
